entries.title: 01 · Sentence becomes a selected benefit
entries.summary: Character reveal, prepared reframe, growing selection, accent rays and late retreat inside one claim.

entries.title: 02 · A question develops inside a pullback
entries.summary: Seven overlapping word arrivals, a growing box, character emphasis, six coins and the foreground phone handoff.

entries.title: 03 · One phone, two explanatory roles
entries.summary: Foreground phone arrival becomes a four-card layout, with full pose controls, typography and the confirmation handoff.

entries.title: Pass attention through focus
entries.summary: Outgoing assets retreat and soften while the next phrase resolves. Includes the rejected blur and pending repair.

entries.title: A warm field, shaped reflections
entries.summary: Separate studio lights, moving ambience and graphic discs to support a clear product silhouette.

entries.title: 03a · Different Wallets
entries.summary: A phone arrives as a dimensional object while two words and expanding circles explain the first friction point.

entries.title: 03b · Separate chains fan from the phone
entries.summary: Four chain cards make fragmentation visible while the phone continues its movement from the wallet claim.

entries.title: 04 · Endless Confirmation
entries.summary: A short two-word claim gains attention during the previous group’s soft exit, then yields to an oversized coin.

entries.title: 05 · The brand coin changes the claim
entries.summary: An oversized turning brand coin becomes a small badge between the words of the answer.

entries.title: 06 · Fingerprint scans and explains
entries.summary: A central fingerprint turns frontal, receives a scan, then makes room for a three-item explanation.

entries.title: 07 · No Seed Phrases / No Chain Switching
entries.summary: Two short negative claims use a bold palette inversion to give the middle of the film a different rhythm.

entries.title: 08 · Seamless experience in a field of UI
entries.summary: Oversized typography reduces into a field of interface panels, then rushes forward while the next system assembles behind it.

entries.title: 09 · One orbital system, three feature visits
entries.summary: One connected system supports Trade, Manage, and Move Assets through successive attention shifts rather than separate feature cards.

entries.title: 10 · The selected benefit returns
entries.summary: The opening selection motif returns as the resolved promise, giving the film a visual callback.

entries.title: 11 · Wordmark and deliberate black tail
entries.summary: The film stops explaining and gives the brand a simple hold before a clean black ending.

entries.title: 01 · A tossed coin becomes a reward
entries.summary: A first-person coin toss supplies an object that carries the film from everyday footage into product UI.

entries.title: 02 · Two payment contexts
entries.summary: Two first-person payment shots ground the graphic reward in recognizable everyday behavior.

entries.title: 03 · A sentence introduces the pack
entries.summary: Short serif statements and a lime package connect spending to a playful reward.

entries.title: 04 · A pack leaves the phone and reveals prizes
entries.summary: The reward pack escapes its screen, becomes a dimensional hero, and opens a field of prizes before yielding to a ticket.

entries.title: 05 · Jackpot type becomes a score screen
entries.summary: A large dimensional amount receives a brief hero moment before the phone score becomes the next focus.

entries.title: 06 · Cafe and grocery payment inserts
entries.summary: Two quick payment inserts reinforce the repeated everyday action between reward explanations.

entries.title: 07 · Salary notification becomes a multiplier wheel
entries.summary: An incoming salary notification becomes a wheel whose result changes the displayed amount.

entries.title: 08 · Grocery and cinema proof beats
entries.summary: Two short point-of-sale shots keep the second reward mechanic connected to spending.

entries.title: 09 · Inputs assemble into a score, then a phone
entries.summary: Individual score factors are explained, then arranged around an aggregate score that returns to the product screen.

entries.title: 10 · A credit panel leaves its UI slot and returns
entries.summary: A locked panel moves beyond the phone boundary, changes state in the foreground, then docks with a readable value.

entries.title: 11 · One purchase expands into many
entries.summary: A last payment shot becomes a circular tile, then a field of repeated purchase moments.

entries.title: 12 · Coin, promise and wordmark
entries.summary: A quiet three-step closing moves from the brand coin to a plain-language promise and final wordmark.

entries.title: 01 · Spend anything, anywhere
entries.summary: A small sentence opens into a colorful dimensional payment-card hero with currencies and graphic accents.

entries.title: 02 · Card glides through rounded tracks
entries.summary: The hero card moves through nested rounded contours, creating a quieter transitional space before the wallet explanation.

entries.title: 03 · A wallet organizes balances
entries.summary: A dimensional wallet presents multiple asset rows, then opens back into a payment-card composition.

entries.title: 04 · Floating balances become the dashboard
entries.summary: The card-and-balances composition resolves into a bright dashboard, then directs attention through its asset list.

entries.title: 05 · Enter an amount and choose a currency
entries.summary: A payment form makes a concrete transaction readable through amount entry, currency choice, and processing.

entries.title: 06 · A payment travels across the globe
entries.summary: A globe and floating notification turn a successful payment into a geographic explanation.

entries.title: 07 · Short claims on the returning purple stage
entries.summary: A rapid typographic bridge returns the film to the card’s visual world before everyday purchase examples.

entries.title: 08 · Coffee, groceries and flights around one phone
entries.summary: One phone supports three purchase categories while a colorful ribbon threads around it.

entries.title: 09 · Same account as a visual hinge
entries.summary: A tiny account symbol turns a two-word statement into the next payment form’s focal anchor.

entries.title: 10 · The send form repeats the transaction
entries.summary: The familiar form returns with an amount and selected payment asset, reinforcing that one account supports the action.

entries.title: 11 · Payment confirmation becomes the final hero
entries.summary: A glass-like notification inherits the colored currency world and becomes large enough to read the completed payment.

entries.title: 12 · Monochrome logo and final promise
entries.summary: White mark and four-point stars on charcoal close the colorful film with a restrained final line.

entries.title: A grid disappears through spatially delayed master curves
entries.summary: One control rig schedules 48 squares by their distance from an off-center control, with independent shrink and flickering opacity.

entries.title: 01 · A logo lands and builds the prompt interface
entries.summary: The interface is constructed in parts around an arriving logo rather than appearing as a finished panel.

entries.title: 02 · Camera sweeps from the request to Send
entries.summary: An oblique close-up resolves focus, then a lateral sweep moves attention along the request toward the circular send control.

entries.title: 03 · The send circle releases its arrow
entries.summary: The circular control survives the interface dissolve, then arrow and disc separate to launch the result.

entries.title: 04 · Result card drops, opens and leaves
entries.summary: A full-sized result card descends from above, hinges aside for a summary, then anticipates an upward exit.
